name: Common Wood-nymph
desc: Common Wood-nymph (Cercyonis pegala): eats plants or other primary food sources. Recorded 16 times near the park in GBIF.
about: The common wood-nymph is a North American species of butterfly in the family Nymphalidae. It is also known as the wood-nymph, grayling, blue-eyed grayling, and the goggle eye.
